reading: Continuity may reduce admissions by letting a physician notice deterioration and manage chronic conditions early, which is why the association is strongest for ambulatory care-sensitive conditions. But sicker patients see more physicians, so severity drives both low continuity and admissions. The single reorganisation study suggests that raising continuity deliberately costs waiting time and may not change admissions quickly.
